newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T shares up as U.S tobacco shares rally.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T shares up as U.S tobacco shares rally.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc climbed on Tuesday, after renewed optimism about the prospects for the tobacco industry's U.S. legal battle boosted Wall Street tobacco stocks, dealers said.
B.A.T shares were up 19-1/2p to 528-1/2 by 1104 GMT on volume of 5.2 million.

Tobacco stocks were hit last week by news of a settlement by cigarette firm Liggett Group. Liggett agreed to hand over potentially damaging documents to 22 states which are seeking to recoup the medical costs of treating smokers from tobacco companies.
But the shares rallied as the tobacco industry fought to limit the damage of the Liggett agreement, led by a rally in Philip Morris Cos Inc shares on Wall Street on Monday.
"All the U.S. tobacco stocks bounced and that's helped B.A.T today," one market-maker said.
